render_registration.measurement_note: Explicit foot/support anchor; body scale is independent of long-tail extent. Alpha>=8 visible bounds; original pixels and full tail retained.

style_policy.note: Reference rendering policy, not a claim that a generated bitmap is pixel-identical at arbitrary future scales. Protect species markings, face, beak, toes and spines.

review.anatomy: Pass: Chestnut/black crown, pale eyebrow, dark eye mask, green/blue upperparts, cream chest, red vent, short tail and substantial legs remain recognizable. The simple brown eye is readable at280px body height and matches the existing bird dot-eye convention.
review.style: Pass: reviewed at registered body scale on cream and dark backgrounds, against Tora / existing Little Bird. Natural same-series contours and texture; small individual variation accepted.
review.alpha: Pass: RGBA with alpha range 0..255, no clipped anatomy, visible matte, checkerboard or halo in proper composites. Source pixels retained unchanged.

designation.name_ja: 高知県指定天然記念物
designation.note: Do not relabel this as a nationally designated Natural Monument. National endangered-species status is a different framework.

recognition_features: Chestnut-brown crown with a dark central stripe.
Cream-yellow eyebrow above a bold dark eye stripe.
Pale cream throat, chest and flanks; red central lower belly and vent.
Green back and shoulder feathers; cobalt-blue rump and short tail tips.
Very short dark tail; compact ground-bird body and relatively long sturdy legs.
